title: Constrained Counterdiabatic Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm for Portfolio Optimization
summary: We introduce a counterdiabatic (CD) extension of the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) for constrained portfolio optimization. By incorporating approximate adiabatic gauge potentials generated from nested commutators of the Ising-type portfolio problem Hamiltonian and the Hamming weight-preserving XY mixer Hamiltonian into our variational ansatz, the resulting Constrained Counterdiabatic QAOA (CCD-QAOA) achieves improved optimization performance under realistic budget and risk constraints. Benchmarking against standard XY-mixer QAOA, Grover-mixer QAOA, and penalty-based QAOA…
